name: Sloosh
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Sloosh makes product images, ad variants and short product videos for online stores and marketing teams, and runs the published Sloosh Spaces in your workspace.

Ask for a studio packshot, a lifestyle scene, a set of ads in feed and story sizes, or a short clip from a product image. Sloosh lists the models that fit the request, and the assistant asks for your approval before it starts paid work. Results appear in a card that updates as each image or clip finishes.

You can also search the published Spaces in your workspace, such as ad grids and UGC-style recipes, check their inputs, and run one after you approve it.

Sloosh works in the Sloosh workspace you connect and follows the spending limit you set in Sloosh settings. It makes one video clip per request and does not join clips or mix audio.

In a coding agent that can run commands on your computer, the plugin also includes a launch film skill. It directs and renders a product launch film with Remotion on your computer, cut to your voiceover, and can use Sloosh images and clips after you approve them. It needs Node.js, ffmpeg and Python on your computer.
